# Team Asterix - Official Website & Engineering Console

> Team Asterix is a pioneering student autonomous mobility & off-road robotics team from PSG iTech, engineering next-generation autonomous vehicles for SAE BAJA.

## Summary & Core Mission
Team Asterix designs, fabricates, and tests fully autonomous off-road vehicles. The team conducts intensive technical workshops, open-source robotics research, and community knowledge sharing.

## Core Subsystems
- **Software & Perception**: ROS2, LiDAR point cloud registration, YOLOv8 object detection, CUDA zero-copy pipelines, and TEB path planning.
- **Powertrain & Electronics**: High-voltage battery isolation, dual CAN bus communication (STM32), drive-by-wire steering, and pneumatic fail-safe braking.
- **Chassis & Mechanical**: AISI 4130 chromoly spaceframe roll cage, 7075-T6 CNC pedal assembly, suspension geometry, and FEA stress analysis.
- **Management & Leads**: Sponsorship relations, event logistics, and technical publications.

## Workshops & Education
Team Asterix offers hands-on curriculum tracks in Autonomous Software, Perception, Powertrain, and Chassis Engineering.
- **Workshop Registration & Schedule**: https://asterix-website.vercel.app/#workshop
- **Workshop Project Submissions**: https://asterix-website.vercel.app/#workshop-project-submit

## Community & Horizon Tech Hub
- **Trending Discussions**: Q&A on ROS2, CAD design, CAN bus telemetry, and workshop projects.
- **Project Showcase**: Open-source student hardware & software builds.
- **Resource Vault**: Downloadable ROS2 cheatsheets, STEP CAD templates, and firmware code.
- **Horizon Tech Blog**: In-depth technical articles written by Team Asterix R&D leads.
- **Community URL**: https://asterix-website.vercel.app/#community
